出血性脑卒中（蛛网膜下腔出血）
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 约85%自发性SAH由颅内动脉瘤破裂所致，典型‘霹雳样剧烈头痛’；约10%–15%患者在到达医院前即因急性颅内压暴增与神经源性心肺骤停猝死，首次出血后24小时内及最初2周再破裂病死率极高（未夹闭/栓塞者早期再出血死亡率可达50%–70%），且第3–14天高发致死性迟发性脑血管痉挛与继发脑梗死。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 急诊24–72小时内血管内弹簧圈栓塞或开颅显微夹闭可根除破裂动脉瘤再出血风险，辅以尼莫地平防治迟发性脑缺血；但早期脑损伤及痉挛所致死残率仍高，总体病死率约25%–35%以上。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021统计全球非创伤性蛛网膜下腔出血年死亡约35万例（0.35 million，IHME GBD 2021 SAH报告）
annual_deaths_global.source: IHME GBD 2021 Non-traumatic SAH Burden Report

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: GBD 2021中国全类型卒中总死亡约260万例，未见官方报告单列中国SAH年度总死亡数；动脉瘤性SAH多发于中壮年，是青壮年非创伤性猝死与脑血管重残的重要原因

epidemiology.prevalence_global: GBD 2021占全部新发卒中约 5.8%（约60万–70万新发例/年）；欧洲获得性动脉瘤性SAH时点患病率约 10.0 / 10万人（Orphanet ORPHA:90065）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国SAH年发病率及动脉瘤检出率随头部CTA/MRA体检普及逐年提升，常发于40–60岁人群且女性略多于男性

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 突发‘一生中最剧烈霹雳样头痛’伴颈强直/意识障碍立即行急诊头颅CT+CTA/DSA确诊（CT发病6小时内敏感性极高，阴性仍高度怀疑者行腰穿）：1）严密卧床镇痛控压（目标收缩压<160 mmHg避免再破裂）；2）尽早（24–72小时内）行血管内介入弹簧圈栓塞或开颅动脉瘤夹闭术封堵动脉瘤；3）全程足疗程（21天）应用尼莫地平预防脑血管痉挛与迟发性脑缺血（DCI）；4）并发急性脑积水立即脑室外引流（EVD）。

clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 因涉及高值介入弹簧圈/密网支架及NICU监护，单次动脉瘤性SAH住院手术总费用通常在6万–15万元人民币以上（未入集采高值神经介入耗材时代更高，近年神经介入弹簧圈省际联盟集采已大幅降价）

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 神经介入领域密网支架（血流导向装置）与新型瘤内扰流装置显著提升了宽颈及复杂破裂动脉瘤闭塞率；药物研发聚焦防治迟发性脑血管痉挛与早期脑损伤，如内皮素受体拮抗剂（Clazosentan在日本/欧美探索）、鞘内缓释尼莫地平微粒（NEWTON项目）及神经炎症靶向阻断；中国神经介入弹簧圈集采（2023–2025多省联盟）大幅压降耗材费用，提高基层急诊栓塞可及性。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1）早期脑损伤与第3–14天迟发性脑缺血尚无除尼莫地平外普适有效的强效神保药物；2）未破裂颅内动脉瘤何时预防性手术仍缺精准流体力学AI预警；3）院前突发破裂抢救窗口极短。

master.definition_en: Pacman dysplasia is characterized by epiphyseal stippling and osteoclastic overactivity. It has been described in less than 10 patients but may be underdiagnosed. It is characterized radiographically by severe stippling of the lower spine and long bones, and periosteal cloaking. Patients also have short metacarpals. The syndrome may be inherited as an autosomal recessive trait. This disorder should be included in the differential diagnosis of mucolipidosis type II. In order to make a definitive diagnosis, lysosomal storage should be investigated by electron microscopy, or enzyme assays should be performed. Familial recurrence can be easily detected by prenatal ultrasonography. This skeletal dysplasia is lethal.

master.definition_en: Atypical lichen myxedematosus is an intermediate form of lichen myxedematosus (LM) (a form of mucin dermal deposit) which does not meet the criteria for either scleromyxedema or the localized form. Three clinical subtypes have been described and include scleromyxedema without monoclonal gammopathy; localized forms with monoclonal gammopathy and/or systemic symptoms; localized forms with mixed features of the 5 subtypes of localized LM (discrete form, acral persistent papular mucinosis, self-healing papular mucinosis, papular mucinosis of infancy, and a pure nodular form). The course of atypical LM is unpredictable because only a few cases have been reported.

master.definition_en: Straddling or overriding tricuspid valve is a rare, congenital, tricuspid valve malformation characterized by the tricuspid valve that overrides the ventricular septum and communicates with both ventricles, as part of the tension apparatus of the valve crosses the ventricular septal defect and is attached in the left ventricle. The anomaly occurs with other congenital heart defects (transposition of great vessels, left ventricle outflow tract obstruction, double outlet right ventricle, hypoplastic right ventricle), which determine the main clinical manifestation.

master.definition_en: Fitz-Hugh-Curtis syndrome (FHCS) is a condition in which a woman has swelling of the tissue covering the liver as a result of having pelvic inflammatory disease (PID). Symptoms most often include pain in the upper right abdomen just below the ribs, fever, nausea, or vomiting. The symptoms of pelvic inflammatory disease - pain in the lower abdomen and vaginal discharge -are oftenpresent as well. FHCS is usually caused by an infection of chlamydia or gonorrhea that leads to PID; it is not known why PIDprogresses toFHCS in some women. Fitz-Hugh-Curtis syndrome is treatedwith antibiotics.

master.definition_en: A rare vascular anomaly characterized by dilation of the internal or the common carotid artery greater than 150% of the diameter of the normal, healthy vessel. Lesions of the carotid bifurcation are typically fusiform, degenerative in nature, and may occur bilaterally, while saccular aneurysms are usually unilateral and mostly located in the middle segment of the internal carotid artery. Symptomatic patients may present with a palpable pulsating mass, local pain, cerebral ischemia, peripheral nerve dysfunction, stridor, or voice changes due to local compression.
